patterns.note: A minimalist, full-bleed layout that transitions from a single hero element to a structured grid with fixed-position sidebars upon scrolling.
Exclusive use of a monospaced font for all textual elements, including navigation, headings, body text, and metadata, creating a consistent, code-like aesthetic.
A high-contrast dark mode palette featuring dark grey backgrounds, off-white text, and a vibrant red used sparingly for accents and interactive elements.

Sophisticated scroll-triggered content transitions: the initial hero content (text and background image/video) changes on scroll, followed by the reveal of left and right sidebars, and subsequent content (images, quotes) fading in and out within the main content area.
Project detail pages consistently feature a main content area for images/videos, a left sidebar for project metadata (client, year), and a right sidebar for related project links or categories.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-driven animation system where the initial hero content dynamically swaps out text and subtly adjusts the background image/video as the user scrolls. Further scrolling triggers the appearance of fixed-position left and right sidebars, which then frame subsequent content sections that fade in and out sequentially.

A consistent, minimal grid system is used, where content areas expand to full width or are contained within a central column, flanked by fixed-position sidebars that appear after the initial hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: minimal hierarchy, almost all text (headings, body, labels) uses a small, monospaced font, with subtle size variations for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the initial hero, transitioning to a balanced, grid-like density with the appearance of sidebars and project content.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its rigorous adherence to a monospaced typeface for all content, creating a unique, almost command-line interface aesthetic. This is combined with a sophisticated, scroll-triggered narrative that transforms the page layout and content dynamically, making the user experience feel highly interactive and curated rather than a static display.
